title: T7 — Statement of Architecture Work
body:
# Statement of Architecture Work — T7 operations

## Assignment

The T7 slice (SPEC_V2 §12) under the programme's architecture governance: operate the estate
through one governed action surface, with the tenant's own approvals on every destructive write.

## Scope

Incidents and triage, the four write verbs, the tenant approval policy and quorum, mitigation and
resolution with a postmortem, host registration and the k8s reads, and the systemic-finding loop.
Not in scope: the process engine (S13) and the procedure catalogue (T18).

## Responsibilities

The operator job requests and acts; the approver job decides every gate and is never its
requester; the programme architect owns the contract and the Phase-G review; the operations owner
owns the incident record.

## Acceptance criteria

SPEC_V2 §12 T7: triage, an approved mitigation with a read-back, resolution with a linked
postmortem, a destructive call without the tenant's approvals refused, and restart/scale/rollback/
flag-flip callable. Proven by the executed suite (`/tmp/u5a-r9/evidence/T7-acceptance.md`).

## Contract

The live delivery contract `01a20ae2-30eb-7f69-812e-e98009182041`, requested by the operator job and approved by the
Architecture Board under the standing delegation `01a1fb9f-ac2d-732d-b274-1079be3dd2b3`; its Phase-G review is compliant
and cites that delegation.
